USE DATABASE <%financial_planning%>;

/*
    usp_ProcessBudgetConsolidation - Complex budget consolidation with hierarchy rollup

    SnowConvert input: Effective definition after SQL Server patches 01-04 (see docs/conversion_input_manifest.md)
    Patches applied here: PCB-01 (#ConsolidatedAmounts), PCB-03 (FinalAmount init), PCB-05 (transaction ownership)

    Excluded vs deployed patch-04 procedure: ForceInsertFailure XML test hook (TC10/TC11 harness only).

    Dependencies: 
        - Tables: BudgetHeader, BudgetLineItem, GLAccount, CostCenter, FiscalPeriod, ConsolidationJournal
        - Views: vw_BudgetConsolidationSummary
        - Functions: fn_GetHierarchyPath, tvf_ExplodeCostCenterHierarchy
        - Types: BudgetLineItemTableType, AllocationResultTableType

    ============================================================================
    MANUAL RESOLUTION OF SNOWCONVERT EWI MARKERS - review these decisions
    ============================================================================
    1. SET XACT_ABORT OFF (SSC-EWI-TS0089) - removed. Snowflake has no equivalent
       setting; the procedure already handles errors explicitly in its EXCEPTION
       block, which is what XACT_ABORT OFF was selected for.

    2. @@TRANCOUNT (SSC-EWI-TS0115) - replaced with
       IFF(CURRENT_TRANSACTION() IS NULL, 0, 1). The source only ever tests this
       for zero/non-zero (does the caller already own a transaction), so a
       boolean-style probe is behaviourally equivalent for this usage. Nested
       transaction depth greater than 1 is not representable and not needed here.

    3. SAVE TRANSACTION / ROLLBACK TO savepoint (SSC-EWI-TS0106, SSC-EWI-TS0083)
       - BEHAVIOURAL DIFFERENCE. Snowflake has no savepoints and no partial
       rollback. The three savepoints (SavePoint_ProcEntry, SavePoint_AfterHeader,
       SavePoint_BeforeEliminations) are removed.
         * Procedure owns the transaction -> full ROLLBACK on error, as before.
         * Caller owns the transaction -> the procedure can no longer undo only
           its own work. It re-raises and leaves the rollback decision to the
           caller, who must roll back to keep the consolidation atomic.
       Callers that relied on partial rollback must be reviewed.

    4. OUTPUT clause (SSC-EWI-0021, two sites) - not supported. Replaced by
       reading back the inserted rows:
         * Target header: the generated BudgetCode is built into a variable
           first and the new BudgetHeaderID is selected back by that code.
         * Inserted lines: re-selected from BudgetLineItem by SourceReference,
           which carries this run's unique CONSOLIDATIONRUNID.

    5. Scrollable / KEYSET / FOR UPDATE cursor (SSC-EWI-TS0037, SSC-EWI-0058,
       SSC-EWI-0073) - EliminationCursor is declared forward-only and read-only.
       Inspection of the source shows every fetch is in fact a FETCH NEXT (the
       "move back if no offset found" comment notwithstanding), so the fetch
       sequence is preserved exactly. The cursor performed no write-back through
       FOR UPDATE OF bli.AdjustedAmount in the body, so nothing is lost.

    6. @@FETCH_STATUS (SSC-EWI-TS0121, three sites) - Snowflake Scripting has no
       fetch-status global. Each fetch target is set to NULL immediately before
       the FETCH; an unchanged NULL afterwards means the cursor was exhausted.

    7. Dynamic SQL (SSC-EWI-0125, SSC-FDM-0131) - the generated statement was
       still T-SQL (UPDATE..FROM, SET @RowCountOUT = @@ROWCOUNT) and could not
       execute on Snowflake. Rewritten as a Snowflake UPDATE, executed with
       EXECUTE IMMEDIATE, with the affected-row count taken from SQLROWCOUNT.
       The two REPLACE() option rewrites are retargeted at the new text.

    8. XACT_STATE() = -1 (SSC-EWI-TS0219) - removed. Snowflake has no
       uncommittable-transaction state, so that branch cannot arise.

    9. CURSOR_STATUS (SSC-FDM-TS0082) - not supported. Cursor cleanup now
       attempts CLOSE inside a nested handler that ignores a not-open error.
    ============================================================================
*/
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE Planning.usp_ProcessBudgetConsolidation (SOURCEBUDGETHEADERID INT, TARGETBUDGETHEADERID OUT INT, CONSOLIDATIONTYPE STRING DEFAULT 'FULL',         -- FULL, INCREMENTAL, DELTA
INCLUDEELIMINATIONS BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1, RECALCULATEALLOCATIONS BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1, PROCESSINGOPTIONS VARIANT DEFAULT NULL, USERID INT DEFAULT NULL, DEBUGMODE BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0, ROWSPROCESSED OUT INT, ERRORMESSAGE OUT STRING)
RETURNS VARCHAR
LANGUAGE SQL
COMMENT = '{ "origin": "sf_sc", "name": "snowconvert", "version": {  "major": 2,  "minor": 54,  "patch": "2-Pr" }, "attributes": {  "component": "transact",  "convertedOn": "11/21/2026",  "domain": "no-domain-provided",  "migrationid": "wACiAZC/6HqmQFXn1qdfyw==" }}'
EXECUTE AS CALLER
AS
$$
    DECLARE

        -- =========================================================================
        -- Variable declarations
        -- =========================================================================
        PROCSTARTTIME TIMESTAMP_NTZ(7);
        STEPSTARTTIME TIMESTAMP_NTZ(7);
        CURRENTSTEP NVARCHAR(100);
        RETURNCODE INT := 0;
        TOTALROWSPROCESSED INT := 0;
        BATCHSIZE INT := 5000;
        CURRENTBATCH INT := 0;
        MAXITERATIONS INT := 1000;
        CONSOLIDATIONRUNID VARCHAR;
        TRANCOUNTATPROCENTRY INT;
        PROCOWNSTRANSACTION BOOLEAN := FALSE;
        CALLEROWNSTRANSACTION BOOLEAN := FALSE;
        NEWBUDGETCODE VARCHAR(60);

        -- =========================================================================
        -- Cursor declarations
        -- =========================================================================
        CURSORCOSTCENTERID INT;
        CURSORLEVEL INT;
        CURSORPARENTID INT;
        CURSORSUBTOTAL DECIMAL(19, 4);
        --** SSC-FDM-TS0013 - SNOWFLAKE SCRIPTING CURSOR ROWS ARE NOT MODIFIABLE **
        HierarchyCursor CURSOR
        FOR
            SELECT
                NodeID,
                NodeLevel,
                ParentNodeID
            FROM
                T_HierarchyNodes
            ORDER BY NodeLevel DESC, NodeID; -- Process bottom-up
    -- Secondary cursor for elimination entries
        ELIMACCOUNTID INT;
        ELIMCOSTCENTERID INT;
        ELIMAMOUNT DECIMAL(19, 4);
        PARTNERENTITYCODE VARCHAR(20);
        ELIMINATIONCOUNT INT := 0;
        -- Check for matching offsetting entry
        OFFSETEXISTS BOOLEAN;
        OFFSETAMOUNT DECIMAL(19, 4);
        -- Manual resolution 5: forward-only, read-only. SCROLL / KEYSET /
        -- FOR UPDATE OF bli.AdjustedAmount are not supported and were unused.
        EliminationCursor CURSOR
        FOR
            SELECT
                bli.GLAccountID,
                bli.CostCenterID,
                bli.FinalAmount,
                gla.StatutoryAccountCode  -- Uses SPARSE column
            FROM <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetLineItem bli
            INNER JOIN <%financial_planning%>.Planning.GLAccount gla ON bli.GLAccountID = gla.GLAccountID
            WHERE bli.BudgetHeaderID = ?
              AND gla.IntercompanyFlag = 1
            ORDER BY bli.GLAccountID, bli.CostCenterID;
        DYNAMICSQL NVARCHAR;
        ALLOCATIONROWCOUNT INT;
        INCLUDEZEROBALANCES BOOLEAN;
        ROUNDINGPRECISION INT;
        INITFINALROWCOUNT INT;
    BEGIN
--        --** SSC-FDM-TS0029 - SET NOCOUNT STATEMENT IS COMMENTED OUT, WHICH IS NOT APPLICABLE IN SNOWFLAKE. **
--        SET NOCOUNT ON;
        -- Manual resolution 1: SET XACT_ABORT OFF removed (no Snowflake equivalent).

        PROCSTARTTIME := SYSDATE();
        CONSOLIDATIONRUNID := UUID_STRING();
        -- Manual resolution 2: @@TRANCOUNT replaced with a caller-transaction probe.
        TRANCOUNTATPROCENTRY := IFF(CURRENT_TRANSACTION() IS NULL, 0, 1);

        -- Table variables - These don't exist in Snowflake
        CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY TABLE T_PROCESSINGLOG (
            LogID INT IDENTITY(1,1) ORDER PRIMARY KEY,
            StepName NVARCHAR(100),
            StartTime TIMESTAMP_NTZ(7),
            EndTime TIMESTAMP_NTZ(7),
            RowsAffected INT,
            StatusCode VARCHAR(20),
            Message NVARCHAR
--                            ,
--            --** SSC-FDM-0021 - CREATE INDEX IS NOT SUPPORTED BY SNOWFLAKE **
--            INDEX IX_StepName (StepName)
        );
        CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY TABLE T_HIERARCHYNODES (
            NodeID INT PRIMARY KEY,
            ParentNodeID INT,
            NodeLevel INT,
            ProcessingOrder INT,
            IsProcessed BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
            SubtotalAmount DECIMAL(19, 4)
--                                         ,
--            --** SSC-FDM-0021 - CREATE INDEX IS NOT SUPPORTED BY SNOWFLAKE **
--            INDEX IX_Level (NodeLevel, IsProcessed)
        );

        -- Patch 02: local temp table #ConsolidatedAmounts (replaces @ConsolidatedAmounts) for sp_executesql scope
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS T_ConsolidatedAmounts;
        CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY TABLE T_ConsolidatedAmounts (
            GLAccountID INT NOT NULL,
            CostCenterID INT NOT NULL,
            FiscalPeriodID INT NOT NULL,
            ConsolidatedAmount DECIMAL(19, 4) NOT NULL,
            EliminationAmount DECIMAL(19, 4) NOT NULL DEFAULT (0) /*** SSC-FDM-0012 - CONSTRAINT NAME 'DF_ConsolidatedAmounts_Elim' IN DEFAULT EXPRESSION CONSTRAINT IS NOT SUPPORTED IN SNOWFLAKE ***/,
            FinalAmount DECIMAL(19, 4) NULL,
            SourceCount INT NULL,
            CONSTRAINT PK_ConsolidatedAmounts PRIMARY KEY (GLAccountID, CostCenterID, FiscalPeriodID)
        );

        -- =========================================================================
        -- TRY-CATCH Error Handling - Different in Snowflake
        -- =========================================================================
        BEGIN
            -- Validate input parameters
            CURRENTSTEP := 'Parameter Validation';
            STEPSTARTTIME := SYSDATE();
            IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
                    <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetHeader
                WHERE
                    BudgetHeaderID = :SOURCEBUDGETHEADERID
            )) THEN
                BEGIN
                    ERRORMESSAGE := 'Source budget header not found: ' || CAST(:SOURCEBUDGETHEADERID AS VARCHAR);
                    --** SSC-FDM-TS0019 - RAISERROR ERROR MESSAGE MAY DIFFER BECAUSE OF THE SQL SERVER STRING FORMAT **
                    SELECT
                        <%AIM_DB%>.PUBLIC.RAISERROR_UDF(:ERRORMESSAGE, 16, 1, array_construct());
                END;
            END IF;
            -- Check if source is locked
            IF (EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM
                    <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetHeader
                WHERE
                    BudgetHeaderID = :SOURCEBUDGETHEADERID
                  AND
                    --** SSC-FDM-TS0191 - TEXT COMPARISON ON A COLUMN DECLARED WITHOUT COLLATE IS CASE AND ACCENT SENSITIVE IN SNOWFLAKE; RESULTS DIFFER IF THE SOURCE DEFAULT COLLATION IS CASE OR ACCENT INSENSITIVE **
                    StatusCode NOT IN ('APPROVED', 'LOCKED')
            )) THEN
            BEGIN
                    ERRORMESSAGE := 'Source budget must be in APPROVED or LOCKED status for consolidation';
                    CALL <%AIM_DB%>.PUBLIC.THROW_UDP(50001, :ERRORMESSAGE, 1);  -- THROW syntax differs from RAISERROR
            END;
            END IF;
            INSERT INTO T_PROCESSINGLOG (StepName, StartTime, EndTime, RowsAffected, StatusCode)
            VALUES (:CURRENTSTEP, :STEPSTARTTIME, SYSDATE(), 0, 'COMPLETED');
            -- =====================================================================
            -- Create or update target budget header
            -- =====================================================================
            CURRENTSTEP := 'Create Target Budget';
            STEPSTARTTIME := SYSDATE();
            IF (:TRANCOUNTATPROCENTRY = 0) THEN
                BEGIN
                    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
                    PROCOWNSTRANSACTION := TRUE;
                END;
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    -- Manual resolution 3: SAVE TRANSACTION SavePoint_ProcEntry removed.
                    -- Snowflake cannot roll back to a savepoint; on error this
                    -- procedure re-raises and the caller must roll back.
                    CALLEROWNSTRANSACTION := TRUE;
                END;
            END IF;
            IF (:TARGETBUDGETHEADERID IS NULL) THEN
                BEGIN
                    -- Manual resolution 4: OUTPUT clause replaced by read-back.
                    -- The generated BudgetCode is computed first so the new
                    -- BudgetHeaderID can be selected back by it.
                    SELECT
                        BudgetCode || '_CONSOL_' || TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() :: TIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDD')
                    INTO
                        :NEWBUDGETCODE
                    FROM
                        <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetHeader
                    WHERE
                        BudgetHeaderID = :SOURCEBUDGETHEADERID;

                    INSERT INTO <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetHeader (BudgetCode, BudgetName, BudgetType, ScenarioType, FiscalYear, StartPeriodID, EndPeriodID, BaseBudgetHeaderID, StatusCode, VersionNumber, ExtendedProperties
                    )
                    SELECT
                        :NEWBUDGETCODE,
                        BudgetName || ' - Consolidated',
                        'CONSOLIDATED',
                        ScenarioType,
                        FiscalYear,
                        StartPeriodID,
                        EndPeriodID,
                        BudgetHeaderID,
                        'DRAFT',
                        1,
                        -- XML modification - very different in Snowflake
                        PARSE_XML(
                        '<Root>' ||
                        '<ConsolidationRun RunID="' || CAST(:CONSOLIDATIONRUNID AS VARCHAR(36)) || '" ' ||
                        'SourceID="' || CAST(:SOURCEBUDGETHEADERID AS VARCHAR(20)) || '" ' ||
                        'Timestamp="' || LEFT(TO_VARCHAR(:PROCSTARTTIME, 'yyyy-mm-dd"T"hh:mi:ss.ff3'), 30) || '"/>' || NVL(CAST(ExtendedProperties AS NVARCHAR), '') ||
                        '</Root>')
                    FROM
                        <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetHeader
                    WHERE
                        BudgetHeaderID = :SOURCEBUDGETHEADERID;

                    SELECT
                        MAX(BudgetHeaderID)
                    INTO
                        :TARGETBUDGETHEADERID
                    FROM
                        <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetHeader
                    WHERE
                        BudgetCode = :NEWBUDGETCODE;

                    IF (:TARGETBUDGETHEADERID IS NULL) THEN
                        BEGIN
                            ERRORMESSAGE := 'Failed to create target budget header';
                            CALL <%AIM_DB%>.PUBLIC.THROW_UDP(50002, :ERRORMESSAGE, 1);
                        END;
                    END IF;
                END;
            END IF;

            -- Manual resolution 3: SAVE TRANSACTION SavePoint_AfterHeader removed.
            INSERT INTO T_PROCESSINGLOG (StepName, StartTime, EndTime, RowsAffected, StatusCode)
            VALUES (:CURRENTSTEP, :STEPSTARTTIME, SYSDATE(), 1, 'COMPLETED');
            -- =====================================================================
            -- Build hierarchy for bottom-up rollup using TVF
            -- =====================================================================
            CURRENTSTEP := 'Build Hierarchy';
            STEPSTARTTIME := SYSDATE();
            INSERT INTO T_HIERARCHYNODES (NodeID, ParentNodeID, NodeLevel, ProcessingOrder)
            SELECT
                h.CostCenterID,
                h.ParentCostCenterID,
                h.HierarchyLevel,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY h.HierarchyLevel DESC NULLS LAST, h.CostCenterID NULLS FIRST)
            FROM
                TABLE(<%financial_planning%>.Planning.tvf_ExplodeCostCenterHierarchy(NULL, 10, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() /*** SSC-FDM-TS0186 - GETDATE() RETURNS THE LOCAL TIME OF THE SQL SERVER HOST; THE CONVERTED CALL FOLLOWS THE SNOWFLAKE SESSION TIMEZONE. SET TIMEZONE TO THE SOURCE SERVER'S ZONE FOR THE USERS THAT RUN THIS CODE ***/ :: TIMESTAMP)) h;  -- CROSS APPLY to TVF

            INSERT INTO T_PROCESSINGLOG (StepName, StartTime, EndTime, RowsAffected, StatusCode)
            VALUES (:CURRENTSTEP, :STEPSTARTTIME, SYSDATE(), :SQLROWCOUNT, 'COMPLETED');
            -- =====================================================================
            -- Process consolidation using cursor (bottom-up hierarchy traversal)
            -- =====================================================================
            CURRENTSTEP := 'Hierarchy Consolidation';
            STEPSTARTTIME := SYSDATE();
            OPEN HierarchyCursor;
            -- Manual resolution 6: NULL sentinel stands in for @@FETCH_STATUS.
            CURSORCOSTCENTERID := NULL;
            FETCH
                HierarchyCursor
            INTO
                :CURSORCOSTCENTERID,
                :CURSORLEVEL,
                :CURSORPARENTID;
            WHILE (:CURSORCOSTCENTERID IS NOT NULL AND :CURRENTBATCH < :MAXITERATIONS) LOOP
                CURRENTBATCH := :CURRENTBATCH + 1;

                -- Calculate subtotal for this node
                SELECT
                    SUM(bli.FinalAmount)
                INTO
                    :CURSORSUBTOTAL
                FROM
                    <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetLineItem bli
                WHERE
                    bli.BudgetHeaderID = :SOURCEBUDGETHEADERID
                  AND bli.CostCenterID = :CURSORCOSTCENTERID;

                -- Add child subtotals (already processed due to bottom-up order)
                SELECT
                    NVL(:CURSORSUBTOTAL, 0) + NVL(SUM(h.SubtotalAmount), 0)
                INTO
                    :CURSORSUBTOTAL
                FROM
                    T_HierarchyNodes h
                WHERE
                    h.ParentNodeID = :CURSORCOSTCENTERID
                  AND h.IsProcessed = TRUE;

                -- Update node
                UPDATE T_HierarchyNodes
                SET
                        SubtotalAmount = :CURSORSUBTOTAL,
                        IsProcessed = TRUE
                WHERE
                        NodeID = :CURSORCOSTCENTERID;
                -- MERGE to update or insert consolidated amounts
                MERGE INTO T_ConsolidatedAmounts AS target
                USING (
                    SELECT
                        bli.GLAccountID,
                        :CURSORCOSTCENTERID AS CostCenterID,
                        bli.FiscalPeriodID,
                        SUM(bli.FinalAmount) AS Amount,
                        COUNT(*) AS SourceCnt
                    FROM
                        <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetLineItem bli
                    WHERE
                        bli.BudgetHeaderID = :SOURCEBUDGETHEADERID
                      AND bli.CostCenterID = :CURSORCOSTCENTERID
                    GROUP BY
                        bli.GLAccountID,

USE DATABASE <%financial_planning%>;

/*
    usp_ExecuteCostAllocation - Step-down cost allocation with recursive dependencies

    Dependencies:
        - Tables: AllocationRule, BudgetLineItem, CostCenter, GLAccount
        - Views: vw_AllocationRuleTargets
        - Functions: fn_GetAllocationFactor
        - Types: AllocationResultTableType

    ============================================================================
    SNOWFLAKE MIGRATION CHALLENGES:
    ============================================================================
    1. Recursive CTE with self-referencing updates
    2. WAITFOR DELAY for throttling - No Snowflake equivalent
    3. sp_getapplock/sp_releaseapplock for locking - Different concurrency model
    4. Table variable as OUTPUT parameter (via workaround)
    5. Nested procedure calls with OUTPUT parameters
    6. GOTO statements for control flow
    7. Multiple temp tables with complex joins
    8. CROSS APPLY to inline TVF with correlation
    9. TRY_CONVERT and TRY_CAST functions
    10. STRING_AGG with ordering
    11. UPDATE with FROM clause and TOP
    12. @@ROWCOUNT immediately after UPDATE in complex expressions
    ============================================================================
*/
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE Planning.usp_ExecuteCostAllocation
    --** SSC-FDM-0041 - DEFAULT PARAMETERS WERE REORDERED TO THE END OF THE PARAMETER LIST TO MATCH SNOWFLAKE REQUIREMENTS. CALLERS USING POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS MAY NEED TO BE UPDATED **
    (
    -- Comma-separated list, NULL = all active rules
    -- NULL = all periods in budget
    -- Delay between iterations
    -- EXCLUSIVE, SHARED, NONE
    -- Input TVP
    BUDGETHEADERID INT, ALLOCATIONRESULTS ARRAY, ROWSALLOCATED OUT INT, WARNINGMESSAGES OUT STRING, ALLOCATIONRULEIDS STRING DEFAULT NULL, FISCALPERIODID INT DEFAULT NULL, DRYRUN BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0, MAXITERATIONS INT DEFAULT 100, THROTTLEDELAYMS INT DEFAULT 0, CONCURRENCYMODE STRING DEFAULT 'EXCLUSIVE')
    RETURNS VARCHAR
    LANGUAGE SQL
    COMMENT = '{ "origin": "sf_sc", "name": "snowconvert", "version": {  "major": 2,  "minor": 54,  "patch": "2-Pr" }, "attributes": {  "component": "transact",  "convertedOn": "11/21/2026",  "domain": "no-domain-provided",  "migrationid": "wACiAZC/6HqmQFXn1qdfyw==" }}'
    EXECUTE AS CALLER
    AS
    $$
        DECLARE
            SC_EXIT_CODE VARCHAR;

            -- =========================================================================
            -- Declarations
            -- =========================================================================
            RETURNCODE INT := 0;
            ITERATIONCOUNT INT := 0;
            ROWSTHISITERATION INT := 1;
            TOTALALLOCATED DECIMAL(19, 4) := 0;
            REMAININGTOALLOCATE DECIMAL(19, 4);
            LOCKRESULT INT;
            WARNINGLIST NVARCHAR := '';
            WAITTIME VARCHAR(12);
            SC_PROCESS PROCEDURE ()
            RETURNS VARCHAR
            AS
                BEGIN
--                    --** SSC-FDM-TS0029 - SET NOCOUNT STATEMENT IS COMMENTED OUT, WHICH IS NOT APPLICABLE IN SNOWFLAKE. **
--                    SET NOCOUNT ON;
                    -- Manual resolution: SET XACT_ABORT ON removed; no Snowflake
                    -- equivalent. Errors are handled by the EXCEPTION block below.
                     
                     
                     
                     
                     
                     
                     

                    -- Temp tables for processing
                    CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY TABLE T_AllocationQueue (
                        QueueID INT IDENTITY(1,1) ORDER PRIMARY KEY,
                        AllocationRuleID INT NOT NULL,
                        SourceBudgetLineItemID BIGINT NOT NULL,
                        SourceAmount DECIMAL(19, 4) NOT NULL,
                        RemainingAmount DECIMAL(19, 4) NOT NULL,
                        ExecutionSequence INT NOT NULL,
                        DependsOnRuleID INT NULL,
                        IsProcessed BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
                        ProcessedDateTime TIMESTAMP_NTZ(7) NULL,
                        ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(500) NULL
--                                                       ,
--                        --** SSC-FDM-0021 - CREATE INDEX IS NOT SUPPORTED BY SNOWFLAKE **
--                        INDEX IX_Sequence (ExecutionSequence, IsProcessed)
);
                    CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY TABLE T_AllocationResults (
                        ResultID INT IDENTITY(1,1) ORDER PRIMARY KEY,
                        SourceBudgetLineItemID BIGINT NOT NULL,
                        TargetCostCenterID INT NOT NULL,
                        TargetGLAccountID INT NOT NULL,
                        AllocatedAmount DECIMAL(19, 4) NOT NULL,
                        AllocationPercentage DECIMAL(8, 6) NOT NULL,
                        AllocationRuleID INT NOT NULL,
                        IterationNumber INT NOT NULL
                    );
                    CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY TABLE T_ProcessedRules (
                        AllocationRuleID INT PRIMARY KEY,
                        ProcessedAt TIMESTAMP_NTZ(7),
                        TotalAllocated DECIMAL(19, 4),
                        TargetCount INT
                    );
                    -- Table for rule dependencies (for step-down processing)
                    CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY TABLE T_RuleDependencies (
                        RuleID INT NOT NULL,
                        DependsOnRuleID INT NOT NULL,
                        DependencyLevel INT NOT NULL,
                        PRIMARY KEY (RuleID, DependsOnRuleID)
);
                    -- =========================================================================
                    -- Acquire application lock for exclusive processing
                    -- =========================================================================
                    IF (:CONCURRENCYMODE = 'EXCLUSIVE') THEN
                    BEGIN
                            !!!RESOLVE EWI!!! /*** SSC-EWI-TS0075 - TRANSLATION FOR BUILT-IN PROCEDURE 'sp_getapplock' IS NOT CURRENTLY SUPPORTED. ***/!!!
                        EXEC @LockResult = sp_getapplock
                            @Resource = 'CostAllocation_Process',
                            @LockMode = 'Exclusive',
                            @LockOwner = 'Session',
                            @LockTimeout = 30000; -- 30 second timeout

                        IF (:LOCKRESULT < 0) THEN
                            BEGIN
                                WARNINGMESSAGES := 'Could not acquire exclusive lock. Another allocation process may be running.';
                                RETURNCODE := -1;
                                BEGIN
                                    CALL CleanupAndExit();
                                    RETURN 'PROCESS FINISHED';
                                END;
                            END;
                        END IF;
                    END;
                    ELSEIF (:CONCURRENCYMODE = 'SHARED') THEN
                    BEGIN
                        !!!RESOLVE EWI!!! /*** SSC-EWI-TS0075 - TRANSLATION FOR BUILT-IN PROCEDURE 'sp_getapplock' IS NOT CURRENTLY SUPPORTED. ***/!!!
                        EXEC @LockResult = sp_getapplock
                            @Resource = 'CostAllocation_Process',
                            @LockMode = 'Shared',
                            @LockOwner = 'Session',
                            @LockTimeout = 10000;
                    END;
                    END IF;
                    BEGIN
                    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
                    -- =====================================================================
                    -- Parse rule list and build dependency graph
                    -- =====================================================================
                    IF (:ALLOCATIONRULEIDS IS NOT NULL) THEN
                    BEGIN
                        -- Use STRING_SPLIT (SQL Server 2016+) - requires refactoring for Snowflake
                        INSERT INTO T_RuleDependencies (RuleID, DependsOnRuleID, DependencyLevel)
                        SELECT
                                ar.AllocationRuleID,
                                ar.DependsOnRuleID,
                            1
                        FROM
                                <%financial_planning%>.Planning.AllocationRule ar
                        INNER JOIN
                                    TABLE(SPLIT_TO_TABLE(:ALLOCATIONRULEIDS, ',')) ss
                            ON ar.AllocationRuleID = TRY_CAST(TO_VARCHAR(LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value))) AS INT)
                        WHERE
                                ar.IsActive = 1
                          AND ar.DependsOnRuleID IS NOT NULL;
                    END;
                    ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        -- All active rules
                        INSERT INTO T_RuleDependencies (RuleID, DependsOnRuleID, DependencyLevel)
                        SELECT
                                ar.AllocationRuleID,
                                ar.DependsOnRuleID,
                            1
                        FROM
                                <%financial_planning%>.Planning.AllocationRule ar
                        WHERE
                                ar.IsActive = 1
                          AND ar.DependsOnRuleID IS NOT NULL
                          AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() /*** SSC-FDM-TS0186 - GETDATE() RETURNS THE LOCAL TIME OF THE SQL SERVER HOST; THE CONVERTED CALL FOLLOWS THE SNOWFLAKE SESSION TIMEZONE. SET TIMEZONE TO THE SOURCE SERVER'S ZONE FOR THE USERS THAT RUN THIS CODE ***/ :: TIMESTAMP BETWEEN ar.EffectiveFromDate AND NVL(ar.EffectiveToDate, '9999-12-31');
                    END

                    -- Build transitive closure of dependencies using recursive CTE
                    ;
                    END IF;
                    INSERT INTO T_RuleDependencies (RuleID, DependsOnRuleID, DependencyLevel)
                    WITH RecursiveDeps AS (
                        -- Anchor: direct dependencies
                        SELECT
                            rd.RuleID,
                            rd.DependsOnRuleID,
                            1 AS Level,
                            CAST(CAST(rd.RuleID AS VARCHAR) || '->' || CAST(rd.DependsOnRuleID AS VARCHAR) AS VARCHAR) AS Path
                        FROM
                            T_RuleDependencies rd

                        UNION ALL

                        -- Recursive: transitive dependencies
                        SELECT
                            r.RuleID,
                            rd.DependsOnRuleID,
                            r.Level + 1,
                            r.Path || '->' || CAST(rd.DependsOnRuleID AS VARCHAR)
                        FROM
                            RecursiveDeps AS r
                        INNER JOIN
                                T_RuleDependencies rd
                                ON r.DependsOnRuleID = rd.RuleID
                        WHERE
                            r.Level < 10  -- Prevent infinite recursion
                          AND CHARINDEX(CAST(rd.DependsOnRuleID AS VARCHAR), r.Path) = 0  -- Cycle detection
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        RuleID,
                        DependsOnRuleID,
                        MAX(Level)
                    FROM
                        RecursiveDeps AS RecursiveDeps
                    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM
                                T_RuleDependencies rd
                        WHERE
                                rd.RuleID = RecursiveDeps.RuleID
                          AND rd.DependsOnRuleID = RecursiveDeps.DependsOnRuleID
                    )
                    GROUP BY
                        RuleID,
                        DependsOnRuleID;

                    -- =====================================================================
                    -- Populate allocation queue using CROSS APPLY to inline TVF
                    -- =====================================================================
                    INSERT INTO T_AllocationQueue (AllocationRuleID, SourceBudgetLineItemID, SourceAmount, RemainingAmount, ExecutionSequence, DependsOnRuleID
                    )
                    SELECT
                        ar.AllocationRuleID,
                        bli.BudgetLineItemID,
                        bli.FinalAmount,
                        bli.FinalAmount,
                        ar.ExecutionSequence,
                        ar.DependsOnRuleID
                    FROM
                        <%financial_planning%>.Planning.AllocationRule ar
                        INNER JOIN
                            LATERAL (
                                           -- Complex APPLY with pattern matching
                                           SELECT bli.*
                                           FROM
                                    <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetLineItem bli
                                           INNER JOIN
                                            <%financial_planning%>.Planning.CostCenter cc
                                            ON bli.CostCenterID = cc.CostCenterID
                                           INNER JOIN
                                            <%financial_planning%>.Planning.GLAccount gla
                                            ON bli.GLAccountID = gla.GLAccountID
                                           WHERE
                                    bli.BudgetHeaderID = :BUDGETHEADERID
                                             AND (:FISCALPERIODID IS NULL OR bli.FiscalPeriodID = :FISCALPERIODID)
                                             AND (ar.SourceCostCenterID IS NULL OR cc.CostCenterID = ar.SourceCostCenterID)
                                             -- Pattern matching using LIKE with escape
                                             AND (ar.SourceCostCenterPattern IS NULL
                                                  OR
                                    --** SSC-FDM-TS0191 - TEXT COMPARISON ON A COLUMN DECLARED WITHOUT COLLATE IS CASE AND ACCENT SENSITIVE IN SNOWFLAKE; RESULTS DIFFER IF THE SOURCE DEFAULT COLLATION IS CASE OR ACCENT INSENSITIVE **
                                    cc.CostCenterCode LIKE ar.SourceCostCenterPattern ESCAPE '\\')
                                             AND (ar.SourceAccountPattern IS NULL
                                                  OR
                                    --** SSC-FDM-TS0191 - TEXT COMPARISON ON A COLUMN DECLARED WITHOUT COLLATE IS CASE AND ACCENT SENSITIVE IN SNOWFLAKE; RESULTS DIFFER IF THE SOURCE DEFAULT COLLATION IS CASE OR ACCENT INSENSITIVE **
                                    gla.AccountNumber LIKE ar.SourceAccountPattern ESCAPE '\\')
                                             AND bli.FinalAmount <> 0
                                             AND bli.IsAllocated = 0
                                       ) bli
                    WHERE
                        ar.IsActive = 1
                      AND (:ALLOCATIONRULEIDS IS NULL
                           OR ar.AllocationRuleID IN (
                               SELECT
                                TRY_CAST(TO_VARCHAR(LTRIM(RTRIM(value))) AS INT)
                               FROM
                                TABLE(SPLIT_TO_TABLE(:ALLOCATIONRULEIDS, ','))
                           ))
                    ORDER BY ar.ExecutionSequence, bli.BudgetLineItemID;
                    -- =====================================================================
                    -- Main allocation loop
                    -- =====================================================================
                    WHILE (:ROWSTHISITERATION > 0 AND :ITERATIONCOUNT < :MAXITERATIONS) LOOP
                        ITERATIONCOUNT := :ITERATIONCOUNT + 1;
                        ROWSTHISITERATION := 0;
                        -- Throttle if requested - WAITFOR has no Snowflake equivalent
                        IF (:THROTTLEDELAYMS > 0 AND :ITERATIONCOUNT > 1) THEN
                        BEGIN
                                WAITTIME := LEFT(TO_VARCHAR(DATEADD(MILLISECOND, :THROTTLEDELAYMS, ('01/01/1900' :: DATE)), 'hh:mi:ss:ff3'), 12);
                                !!!RESOLVE EWI!!! /*** SSC-EWI-TS0094 - WAITFOR DELAY WITH VARIABLE ':WAITTIME' WAS CONVERTED TO SYSTEM$WAIT, BUT THE VARIABLE MAY CONTAIN A TIME STRING IN 'HH:MM:SS' FORMAT. SYSTEM$WAIT EXPECTS A NUMERIC VALUE IN SECONDS. ***/!!!
                                CALL SYSTEM$WAIT(:WAITTIME);
                        END

                        -- Process rules in sequence, respecting dependencies
                        -- Use UPDATE with TOP to process in batches
                        ;
                        END IF;
                        UPDATE T_AllocationQueue q
                        SET
                                q.IsProcessed = 1,
                                q.ProcessedDateTime = SYSDATE()
                        FROM
                                (
                                    WITH OrderedQueue AS (
                            SELECT
                            TOP 1000
                                                q.*
                            FROM
                                                T_AllocationQueue q
                            WHERE
                                                q.IsProcessed = 0
                            AND (q.DependsOnRuleID IS NULL
                                OR EXISTS
                                          --** SSC-FDM-0002 - CORRELATED SUBQUERIES MAY HAVE SOME FUNCTIONAL DIFFERENCES. **
                                          (SELECT 1 FROM
                                                  T_ProcessedRules pr
                                              WHERE
                                                  pr.AllocationRuleID = q.DependsOnRuleID
                                          ))
                            ORDER BY q.ExecutionSequence NULLS FIRST, q.QueueID NULLS FIRST
                        )
                                    SELECT
                            *
                                    FROM
                            OrderedQueue
                                ) AS q
                        !!!RESOLVE EWI!!! /*** SSC-EWI-0021 - OUTPUT CLAUSE NOT SUPPORTED IN SNOWFLAKE ***/!!!
                        OUTPUT
                            deleted.SourceBudgetLineItemID,
                            deleted.AllocationRuleID,
                            deleted.SourceAmount,
                            deleted.RemainingAmount
                        INTO #AllocationResults (SourceBudgetLineItemID, AllocationRuleID, AllocatedAmount, AllocationPercentage);
                        ROWSTHISITERATION := SQLROWCOUNT;
                        -- Perform actual allocations for this batch
                        IF (:ROWSTHISITERATION > 0) THEN
                        BEGIN
                            -- Complex allocation calculation using scalar function
                            INSERT INTO T_AllocationResults (SourceBudgetLineItemID, TargetCostCenterID, TargetGLAccountID, AllocatedAmount, AllocationPercentage, AllocationRuleID, IterationNumber
                            )
                            SELECT
                                    q.SourceBudgetLineItemID,
                                    vt.TargetCostCenterID,
                                    bli.GLAccountID,
                                CASE
                                    WHEN
                            --** SSC-FDM-TS0191 - TEXT COMPARISON ON A COLUMN DECLARED WITHOUT COLLATE IS CASE AND ACCENT SENSITIVE IN SNOWFLAKE; RESULTS DIFFER IF THE SOURCE DEFAULT COLLATION IS CASE OR ACCENT INSENSITIVE **
                            ar.RoundingMethod = 'UP' THEN CEIL(q.RemainingAmount * vt.TargetAllocationPct * 100) / 100
                                    WHEN
                            --** SSC-FDM-TS0191 - TEXT COMPARISON ON A COLUMN DECLARED WITHOUT COLLATE IS CASE AND ACCENT SENSITIVE IN SNOWFLAKE; RESULTS DIFFER IF THE SOURCE DEFAULT COLLATION IS CASE OR ACCENT INSENSITIVE **
                            ar.RoundingMethod = 'DOWN' THEN FLOOR(q.RemainingAmount * vt.TargetAllocationPct * 100) / 100
                                    ELSE ROUND(q.RemainingAmount * <%financial_planning%>.Planning.fn_GetAllocationFactor(bli.CostCenterID, vt.TargetCostCenterID, ar.AllocationBasis, bli.FiscalPeriodID, :BUDGETHEADERID
                                         ), 2)
                                END,
                                    NVL(vt.TargetAllocationPct, <%financial_planning%>.Planning.fn_GetAllocationFactor(bli.CostCenterID, vt.TargetCostCenterID, ar.AllocationBasis, bli.FiscalPeriodID, :BUDGETHEADERID
                                       )),
                                    q.AllocationRuleID,
                                    :ITERATIONCOUNT
                            FROM
                                    T_AllocationQueue q
                            INNER JOIN
                            <%financial_planning%>.Planning.AllocationRule ar
                            ON q.AllocationRuleID = ar.AllocationRuleID
                            INNER JOIN
                            <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetLineItem bli
                            ON q.SourceBudgetLineItemID = bli.BudgetLineItemID
                                    INNER JOIN
                            LATERAL (
                                                                   SELECT
                                              *
                                                FROM
                                              <%financial_planning%>.Planning.vw_AllocationRuleTargets vt
                                                                   WHERE
                                              vt.AllocationRuleID = ar.AllocationRuleID
                                                                     AND vt.TargetIsActive = 1
                                                               ) vt
                            WHERE
                                    q.ProcessedDateTime IS NOT NULL
                              AND q.ProcessedDateTime >= DATEADD(SECOND, -5, SYSDATE());
                                -- Track processed rules
                                MERGE INTO T_ProcessedRules AS target
                                USING (
                                    SELECT
                            AllocationRuleID,
                            SYSDATE() AS ProcessedAt,
                            SUM(AllocatedAmount) AS TotalAllocated,
                            COUNT(*) AS TargetCount
                                    FROM
                            T_AllocationResults
                                    WHERE
                            IterationNumber = :ITERATIONCOUNT
                                    GROUP BY
                            AllocationRuleID
                                ) AS source
                                ON target.AllocationRuleID = source.AllocationRuleID
                                WHEN MATCHED THEN
                                    UPDATE SET
                            TotalAllocated = target.TotalAllocated + source.TotalAllocated,

                        END;
                        END IF;
                    END LOOP;

                    -- =====================================================================
                    -- Persist results (unless dry run)
                    -- =====================================================================
                    IF (:DRYRUN = 0) THEN
                    BEGIN
                        -- Insert allocated line items
                        INSERT INTO <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetLineItem (BudgetHeaderID, GLAccountID, CostCenterID, FiscalPeriodID, OriginalAmount, AdjustedAmount, IsAllocated, AllocationSourceLineID, AllocationPercentage, LastModifiedDateTime
                        )
                        SELECT
                                :BUDGETHEADERID,
                                ar.TargetGLAccountID,
                                ar.TargetCostCenterID,
                                bli.FiscalPeriodID,
                                ar.AllocatedAmount,
                            0,
                            1,
                                ar.SourceBudgetLineItemID,
                                ar.AllocationPercentage,
                                SYSDATE()
                        FROM
                                T_AllocationResults ar
                        INNER JOIN
                                    <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetLineItem bli

                    -- =====================================================================
                    WARNINGMESSAGES := (
                        SELECT
                        LISTAGG(CONCAT('Rule ', COALESCE(AllocationRuleID :: STRING, ''), ': ', COALESCE(ErrorMessage :: STRING, '')),
                            '; '
                        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY QueueID)  -- STRING_AGG with ORDER BY
                        FROM
                        T_AllocationQueue
                        WHERE
                        ErrorMessage IS NOT NULL
                    );

                    IF (:ITERATIONCOUNT >= :MAXITERATIONS) THEN
                    BEGIN
                        WARNINGMESSAGES := CONCAT(COALESCE(:WARNINGMESSAGES :: STRING, ''),
                        '; WARNING: Max iterations (', COALESCE(:MAXITERATIONS :: STRING, ''), ') reached. Some allocations may be incomplete.');
                    END;
                    END IF;
                    COMMIT;
                    EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHER THEN
                        IF (CURRENT_TRANSACTION() IS NOT NULL) THEN
                        ROLLBACK AllocationTran !!!RESOLVE EWI!!! /*** SSC-EWI-0073 - PENDING FUNCTIONAL EQUIVALENCE REVIEW FOR 'RollbackName' NODE ***/!!!;
                        END IF;

                        RETURNCODE := :SQLCODE /*** SSC-FDM-TS0023 - ERROR NUMBER COULD BE DIFFERENT IN SNOWFLAKE ***/;
                    END;

            CleanupAndExit PROCEDURE ()
            RETURNS VARCHAR
            AS
                BEGIN
                    -- Release application lock

                    BEGIN
                        !!!RESOLVE EWI!!! /*** SSC-EWI-TS0075 - TRANSLATION FOR BUILT-IN PROCEDURE 'sp_releaseapplock' IS NOT CURRENTLY SUPPORTED. ***/!!!
                        EXEC sp_releaseapplock
                            @Resource = 'CostAllocation_Process',
                            @LockOwner = 'Session';
                    END;
                    END IF;
    -- Cleanup temp tables
                    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS T_AllocationQueue;
                    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS T_AllocationResults;
                    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS T_ProcessedRules;
                    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS T_RuleDependencies;

USE DATABASE <%financial_planning%>;

/*
    usp_ExecuteCostAllocation - Step-down cost allocation with recursive dependencies

    Dependencies:
        - Tables: AllocationRule, BudgetLineItem, CostCenter, GLAccount
        - Views: vw_AllocationRuleTargets
        - Functions: fn_GetAllocationFactor
        - Types: AllocationResultTableType

    ============================================================================
    SNOWFLAKE MIGRATION CHALLENGES:
    ============================================================================
    1. Recursive CTE with self-referencing updates
    2. WAITFOR DELAY for throttling - No Snowflake equivalent
    3. sp_getapplock/sp_releaseapplock for locking - Different concurrency model
    4. Table variable as OUTPUT parameter (via workaround)
    5. Nested procedure calls with OUTPUT parameters
    6. GOTO statements for control flow
    7. Multiple temp tables with complex joins
    8. CROSS APPLY to inline TVF with correlation
    9. TRY_CONVERT and TRY_CAST functions
    10. STRING_AGG with ordering
    11. UPDATE with FROM clause and TOP
    12. @@ROWCOUNT immediately after UPDATE in complex expressions
    ============================================================================
*/
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE Planning.usp_ExecuteCostAllocation
    --** SSC-FDM-0041 - DEFAULT PARAMETERS WERE REORDERED TO THE END OF THE PARAMETER LIST TO MATCH SNOWFLAKE REQUIREMENTS. CALLERS USING POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS MAY NEED TO BE UPDATED **
    (
    -- Comma-separated list, NULL = all active rules
    -- NULL = all periods in budget
    -- Delay between iterations
    -- EXCLUSIVE, SHARED, NONE
    -- Input TVP
    BUDGETHEADERID INT, ALLOCATIONRESULTS ARRAY, ROWSALLOCATED OUT INT, WARNINGMESSAGES OUT STRING, ALLOCATIONRULEIDS STRING DEFAULT NULL, FISCALPERIODID INT DEFAULT NULL, DRYRUN BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0, MAXITERATIONS INT DEFAULT 100, THROTTLEDELAYMS INT DEFAULT 0, CONCURRENCYMODE STRING DEFAULT 'EXCLUSIVE')
    RETURNS VARCHAR
    LANGUAGE SQL
    COMMENT = '{ "origin": "sf_sc", "name": "snowconvert", "version": {  "major": 2,  "minor": 54,  "patch": "2-Pr" }, "attributes": {  "component": "transact",  "convertedOn": "11/21/2026",  "domain": "no-domain-provided",  "migrationid": "wACiAZC/6HqmQFXn1qdfyw==" }}'
    EXECUTE AS CALLER
    AS
    $$
        DECLARE
            SC_EXIT_CODE VARCHAR;

            -- =========================================================================
            -- Declarations
            -- =========================================================================
            RETURNCODE INT := 0;
            ITERATIONCOUNT INT := 0;
            ROWSTHISITERATION INT := 1;
            TOTALALLOCATED DECIMAL(19, 4) := 0;
            REMAININGTOALLOCATE DECIMAL(19, 4);
            LOCKRESULT INT;
            WARNINGLIST NVARCHAR := '';
            WAITTIME VARCHAR(12);
            SC_PROCESS PROCEDURE ()
            RETURNS VARCHAR
            AS
                BEGIN
--                    --** SSC-FDM-TS0029 - SET NOCOUNT STATEMENT IS COMMENTED OUT, WHICH IS NOT APPLICABLE IN SNOWFLAKE. **
--                    SET NOCOUNT ON;
                    !!!RESOLVE EWI!!! /*** SSC-EWI-TS0089 - SET XACT_ABORT ON IS NOT SUPPORTED IN SNOWFLAKE. ***/!!!
                    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
                     
                     
                     
                     
                     
                     
                     

                    -- Temp tables for processing
                    CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY TABLE T_AllocationQueue (
                        QueueID INT IDENTITY(1,1) ORDER PRIMARY KEY,
                        AllocationRuleID INT NOT NULL,
                        SourceBudgetLineItemID BIGINT NOT NULL,
                        SourceAmount DECIMAL(19, 4) NOT NULL,
                        RemainingAmount DECIMAL(19, 4) NOT NULL,
                        ExecutionSequence INT NOT NULL,
                        DependsOnRuleID INT NULL,
                        IsProcessed BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
                        ProcessedDateTime TIMESTAMP_NTZ(7) NULL,
                        ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(500) NULL
--                                                       ,
--                        --** SSC-FDM-0021 - CREATE INDEX IS NOT SUPPORTED BY SNOWFLAKE **
--                        INDEX IX_Sequence (ExecutionSequence, IsProcessed)
);
                    CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY TABLE T_AllocationResults (
                        ResultID INT IDENTITY(1,1) ORDER PRIMARY KEY,
                        SourceBudgetLineItemID BIGINT NOT NULL,
                        TargetCostCenterID INT NOT NULL,
                        TargetGLAccountID INT NOT NULL,
                        AllocatedAmount DECIMAL(19, 4) NOT NULL,
                        AllocationPercentage DECIMAL(8, 6) NOT NULL,
                        AllocationRuleID INT NOT NULL,
                        IterationNumber INT NOT NULL
                    );
                    CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY TABLE T_ProcessedRules (
                        AllocationRuleID INT PRIMARY KEY,
                        ProcessedAt TIMESTAMP_NTZ(7),
                        TotalAllocated DECIMAL(19, 4),
                        TargetCount INT
                    );
                    -- Table for rule dependencies (for step-down processing)
                    CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY TABLE T_RuleDependencies (
                        RuleID INT NOT NULL,
                        DependsOnRuleID INT NOT NULL,
                        DependencyLevel INT NOT NULL,
                        PRIMARY KEY (RuleID, DependsOnRuleID)
);
                    -- =========================================================================
                    -- Acquire application lock for exclusive processing
                    -- =========================================================================
                    IF (:CONCURRENCYMODE = 'EXCLUSIVE') THEN
                    BEGIN
                            !!!RESOLVE EWI!!! /*** SSC-EWI-TS0075 - TRANSLATION FOR BUILT-IN PROCEDURE 'sp_getapplock' IS NOT CURRENTLY SUPPORTED. ***/!!!
                        EXEC @LockResult = sp_getapplock
                            @Resource = 'CostAllocation_Process',
                            @LockMode = 'Exclusive',
                            @LockOwner = 'Session',
                            @LockTimeout = 30000; -- 30 second timeout

                        IF (:LOCKRESULT < 0) THEN
                            BEGIN
                                WARNINGMESSAGES := 'Could not acquire exclusive lock. Another allocation process may be running.';
                                RETURNCODE := -1;
                                BEGIN
                                    CALL CleanupAndExit();
                                    RETURN 'PROCESS FINISHED';
                                END;
                            END;
                        END IF;
                    END;
                    ELSEIF (:CONCURRENCYMODE = 'SHARED') THEN
                    BEGIN
                        !!!RESOLVE EWI!!! /*** SSC-EWI-TS0075 - TRANSLATION FOR BUILT-IN PROCEDURE 'sp_getapplock' IS NOT CURRENTLY SUPPORTED. ***/!!!
                        EXEC @LockResult = sp_getapplock
                            @Resource = 'CostAllocation_Process',
                            @LockMode = 'Shared',
                            @LockOwner = 'Session',
                            @LockTimeout = 10000;
                    END;
                    END IF;
                    BEGIN
                    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
                    -- =====================================================================
                    -- Parse rule list and build dependency graph
                    -- =====================================================================
                    IF (:ALLOCATIONRULEIDS IS NOT NULL) THEN
                    BEGIN
                        -- Use STRING_SPLIT (SQL Server 2016+) - requires refactoring for Snowflake
                        INSERT INTO T_RuleDependencies (RuleID, DependsOnRuleID, DependencyLevel)
                        SELECT
                                ar.AllocationRuleID,
                                ar.DependsOnRuleID,
                            1
                        FROM
                                <%financial_planning%>.Planning.AllocationRule ar
                        INNER JOIN
                                    TABLE(SPLIT_TO_TABLE(:ALLOCATIONRULEIDS, ',')) ss
                            ON ar.AllocationRuleID = TRY_CAST(TO_VARCHAR(LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value))) AS INT)
                        WHERE
                                ar.IsActive = 1
                          AND ar.DependsOnRuleID IS NOT NULL;
                    END;
                    ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        -- All active rules
                        INSERT INTO T_RuleDependencies (RuleID, DependsOnRuleID, DependencyLevel)
                        SELECT
                                ar.AllocationRuleID,
                                ar.DependsOnRuleID,
                            1
                        FROM
                                <%financial_planning%>.Planning.AllocationRule ar
                        WHERE
                                ar.IsActive = 1
                          AND ar.DependsOnRuleID IS NOT NULL
                          AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() /*** SSC-FDM-TS0186 - GETDATE() RETURNS THE LOCAL TIME OF THE SQL SERVER HOST; THE CONVERTED CALL FOLLOWS THE SNOWFLAKE SESSION TIMEZONE. SET TIMEZONE TO THE SOURCE SERVER'S ZONE FOR THE USERS THAT RUN THIS CODE ***/ :: TIMESTAMP BETWEEN ar.EffectiveFromDate AND NVL(ar.EffectiveToDate, '9999-12-31');
                    END

                    -- Build transitive closure of dependencies using recursive CTE
                    ;
                    END IF;
                    INSERT INTO T_RuleDependencies (RuleID, DependsOnRuleID, DependencyLevel)
                    WITH RecursiveDeps AS (
                        -- Anchor: direct dependencies
                        SELECT
                            rd.RuleID,
                            rd.DependsOnRuleID,
                            1 AS Level,
                            CAST(CAST(rd.RuleID AS VARCHAR) || '->' || CAST(rd.DependsOnRuleID AS VARCHAR) AS VARCHAR) AS Path
                        FROM
                            T_RuleDependencies rd

                        UNION ALL

                        -- Recursive: transitive dependencies
                        SELECT
                            r.RuleID,
                            rd.DependsOnRuleID,
                            r.Level + 1,
                            r.Path || '->' || CAST(rd.DependsOnRuleID AS VARCHAR)
                        FROM
                            RecursiveDeps AS r
                        INNER JOIN
                                T_RuleDependencies rd
                                ON r.DependsOnRuleID = rd.RuleID
                        WHERE
                            r.Level < 10  -- Prevent infinite recursion
                          AND CHARINDEX(CAST(rd.DependsOnRuleID AS VARCHAR), r.Path) = 0  -- Cycle detection
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        RuleID,
                        DependsOnRuleID,
                        MAX(Level)
                    FROM
                        RecursiveDeps AS RecursiveDeps
                    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM
                                T_RuleDependencies rd
                        WHERE
                                rd.RuleID = RecursiveDeps.RuleID
                          AND rd.DependsOnRuleID = RecursiveDeps.DependsOnRuleID
                    )
                    GROUP BY
                        RuleID,
                        DependsOnRuleID;

                    -- =====================================================================
                    -- Populate allocation queue using CROSS APPLY to inline TVF
                    -- =====================================================================
                    INSERT INTO T_AllocationQueue (AllocationRuleID, SourceBudgetLineItemID, SourceAmount, RemainingAmount, ExecutionSequence, DependsOnRuleID
                    )
                    SELECT
                        ar.AllocationRuleID,
                        bli.BudgetLineItemID,
                        bli.FinalAmount,
                        bli.FinalAmount,
                        ar.ExecutionSequence,
                        ar.DependsOnRuleID
                    FROM
                        <%financial_planning%>.Planning.AllocationRule ar
                        INNER JOIN
                            LATERAL (
                                           -- Complex APPLY with pattern matching
                                           SELECT bli.*
                                           FROM
                                    <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetLineItem bli
                                           INNER JOIN
                                            <%financial_planning%>.Planning.CostCenter cc
                                            ON bli.CostCenterID = cc.CostCenterID
                                           INNER JOIN
                                            <%financial_planning%>.Planning.GLAccount gla
                                            ON bli.GLAccountID = gla.GLAccountID
                                           WHERE
                                    bli.BudgetHeaderID = :BUDGETHEADERID
                                             AND (:FISCALPERIODID IS NULL OR bli.FiscalPeriodID = :FISCALPERIODID)
                                             AND (ar.SourceCostCenterID IS NULL OR cc.CostCenterID = ar.SourceCostCenterID)
                                             -- Pattern matching using LIKE with escape
                                             AND (ar.SourceCostCenterPattern IS NULL
                                                  OR
                                    --** SSC-FDM-TS0191 - TEXT COMPARISON ON A COLUMN DECLARED WITHOUT COLLATE IS CASE AND ACCENT SENSITIVE IN SNOWFLAKE; RESULTS DIFFER IF THE SOURCE DEFAULT COLLATION IS CASE OR ACCENT INSENSITIVE **
                                    cc.CostCenterCode LIKE ar.SourceCostCenterPattern ESCAPE '\\')
                                             AND (ar.SourceAccountPattern IS NULL
                                                  OR
                                    --** SSC-FDM-TS0191 - TEXT COMPARISON ON A COLUMN DECLARED WITHOUT COLLATE IS CASE AND ACCENT SENSITIVE IN SNOWFLAKE; RESULTS DIFFER IF THE SOURCE DEFAULT COLLATION IS CASE OR ACCENT INSENSITIVE **
                                    gla.AccountNumber LIKE ar.SourceAccountPattern ESCAPE '\\')
                                             AND bli.FinalAmount <> 0
                                             AND bli.IsAllocated = 0
                                       ) bli
                    WHERE
                        ar.IsActive = 1
                      AND (:ALLOCATIONRULEIDS IS NULL
                           OR ar.AllocationRuleID IN (
                               SELECT
                                TRY_CAST(TO_VARCHAR(LTRIM(RTRIM(value))) AS INT)
                               FROM
                                TABLE(SPLIT_TO_TABLE(:ALLOCATIONRULEIDS, ','))
                           ))
                    ORDER BY ar.ExecutionSequence, bli.BudgetLineItemID;
                    -- =====================================================================
                    -- Main allocation loop
                    -- =====================================================================
                    WHILE (:ROWSTHISITERATION > 0 AND :ITERATIONCOUNT < :MAXITERATIONS) LOOP
                        ITERATIONCOUNT := :ITERATIONCOUNT + 1;
                        ROWSTHISITERATION := 0;
                        -- Throttle if requested - WAITFOR has no Snowflake equivalent
                        IF (:THROTTLEDELAYMS > 0 AND :ITERATIONCOUNT > 1) THEN
                        BEGIN
                                WAITTIME := LEFT(TO_VARCHAR(DATEADD(MILLISECOND, :THROTTLEDELAYMS, ('01/01/1900' :: DATE)), 'hh:mi:ss:ff3'), 12);
                                !!!RESOLVE EWI!!! /*** SSC-EWI-TS0094 - WAITFOR DELAY WITH VARIABLE ':WAITTIME' WAS CONVERTED TO SYSTEM$WAIT, BUT THE VARIABLE MAY CONTAIN A TIME STRING IN 'HH:MM:SS' FORMAT. SYSTEM$WAIT EXPECTS A NUMERIC VALUE IN SECONDS. ***/!!!
                                CALL SYSTEM$WAIT(:WAITTIME);
                        END

                        -- Process rules in sequence, respecting dependencies
                        -- Use UPDATE with TOP to process in batches
                        ;
                        END IF;
                        UPDATE T_AllocationQueue q
                        SET
                                q.IsProcessed = 1,
                                q.ProcessedDateTime = SYSDATE()
                        FROM
                                (
                                    WITH OrderedQueue AS (
                            SELECT
                            TOP 1000
                                                q.*
                            FROM
                                                T_AllocationQueue q
                            WHERE
                                                q.IsProcessed = 0
                            AND (q.DependsOnRuleID IS NULL
                                OR EXISTS
                                          --** SSC-FDM-0002 - CORRELATED SUBQUERIES MAY HAVE SOME FUNCTIONAL DIFFERENCES. **
                                          (SELECT 1 FROM
                                                  T_ProcessedRules pr
                                              WHERE
                                                  pr.AllocationRuleID = q.DependsOnRuleID
                                          ))
                            ORDER BY q.ExecutionSequence NULLS FIRST, q.QueueID NULLS FIRST
                        )
                                    SELECT
                            *
                                    FROM
                            OrderedQueue
                                ) AS q
                        !!!RESOLVE EWI!!! /*** SSC-EWI-0021 - OUTPUT CLAUSE NOT SUPPORTED IN SNOWFLAKE ***/!!!
                        OUTPUT
                            deleted.SourceBudgetLineItemID,
                            deleted.AllocationRuleID,
                            deleted.SourceAmount,
                            deleted.RemainingAmount
                        INTO #AllocationResults (SourceBudgetLineItemID, AllocationRuleID, AllocatedAmount, AllocationPercentage);
                        ROWSTHISITERATION := SQLROWCOUNT;
                        -- Perform actual allocations for this batch
                        IF (:ROWSTHISITERATION > 0) THEN
                        BEGIN
                            -- Complex allocation calculation using scalar function
                            INSERT INTO T_AllocationResults (SourceBudgetLineItemID, TargetCostCenterID, TargetGLAccountID, AllocatedAmount, AllocationPercentage, AllocationRuleID, IterationNumber
                            )
                            SELECT
                                    q.SourceBudgetLineItemID,
                                    vt.TargetCostCenterID,
                                    bli.GLAccountID,
                                CASE
                                    WHEN
                            --** SSC-FDM-TS0191 - TEXT COMPARISON ON A COLUMN DECLARED WITHOUT COLLATE IS CASE AND ACCENT SENSITIVE IN SNOWFLAKE; RESULTS DIFFER IF THE SOURCE DEFAULT COLLATION IS CASE OR ACCENT INSENSITIVE **
                            ar.RoundingMethod = 'UP' THEN CEIL(q.RemainingAmount * vt.TargetAllocationPct * 100) / 100
                                    WHEN
                            --** SSC-FDM-TS0191 - TEXT COMPARISON ON A COLUMN DECLARED WITHOUT COLLATE IS CASE AND ACCENT SENSITIVE IN SNOWFLAKE; RESULTS DIFFER IF THE SOURCE DEFAULT COLLATION IS CASE OR ACCENT INSENSITIVE **
                            ar.RoundingMethod = 'DOWN' THEN FLOOR(q.RemainingAmount * vt.TargetAllocationPct * 100) / 100
                                    ELSE ROUND(q.RemainingAmount * <%financial_planning%>.Planning.fn_GetAllocationFactor(bli.CostCenterID, vt.TargetCostCenterID, ar.AllocationBasis, bli.FiscalPeriodID, :BUDGETHEADERID
                                         ), 2)
                                END,
                                    NVL(vt.TargetAllocationPct, <%financial_planning%>.Planning.fn_GetAllocationFactor(bli.CostCenterID, vt.TargetCostCenterID, ar.AllocationBasis, bli.FiscalPeriodID, :BUDGETHEADERID
                                       )),
                                    q.AllocationRuleID,
                                    :ITERATIONCOUNT
                            FROM
                                    T_AllocationQueue q
                            INNER JOIN
                            <%financial_planning%>.Planning.AllocationRule ar
                            ON q.AllocationRuleID = ar.AllocationRuleID
                            INNER JOIN
                            <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetLineItem bli
                            ON q.SourceBudgetLineItemID = bli.BudgetLineItemID
                                    INNER JOIN
                            LATERAL (
                                                                   SELECT
                                              *
                                                FROM
                                              <%financial_planning%>.Planning.vw_AllocationRuleTargets vt
                                                                   WHERE
                                              vt.AllocationRuleID = ar.AllocationRuleID
                                                                     AND vt.TargetIsActive = 1
                                                               ) vt
                            WHERE
                                    q.ProcessedDateTime IS NOT NULL
                              AND q.ProcessedDateTime >= DATEADD(SECOND, -5, SYSDATE());
                                -- Track processed rules
                                MERGE INTO T_ProcessedRules AS target
                                USING (
                                    SELECT
                            AllocationRuleID,
                            SYSDATE() AS ProcessedAt,
                            SUM(AllocatedAmount) AS TotalAllocated,
                            COUNT(*) AS TargetCount
                                    FROM
                            T_AllocationResults
                                    WHERE
                            IterationNumber = :ITERATIONCOUNT
                                    GROUP BY
                            AllocationRuleID
                                ) AS source
                                ON target.AllocationRuleID = source.AllocationRuleID
                                WHEN MATCHED THEN
                                    UPDATE SET
                            TotalAllocated = target.TotalAllocated + source.TotalAllocated,
                            TargetCount = target.TargetCount + source.TargetCount
                                WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                                    INSERT (AllocationRuleID, ProcessedAt, TotalAllocated, TargetCount)
                                    VALUES (source.AllocationRuleID, source.ProcessedAt, source.TotalAllocated, source.TargetCount);
                        END;
                        END IF;
                    END LOOP;

                    -- =====================================================================
                    -- Persist results (unless dry run)
                    -- =====================================================================
                    IF (:DRYRUN = 0) THEN
                    BEGIN
                        -- Insert allocated line items
                        INSERT INTO <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetLineItem (BudgetHeaderID, GLAccountID, CostCenterID, FiscalPeriodID, OriginalAmount, AdjustedAmount, IsAllocated, AllocationSourceLineID, AllocationPercentage, LastModifiedDateTime
                        )
                        SELECT
                                :BUDGETHEADERID,
                                ar.TargetGLAccountID,
                                ar.TargetCostCenterID,
                                bli.FiscalPeriodID,
                                ar.AllocatedAmount,
                            0,
                            1,
                                ar.SourceBudgetLineItemID,
                                ar.AllocationPercentage,
                                SYSDATE()
                        FROM
                                T_AllocationResults ar
                        INNER JOIN
                                    <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetLineItem bli
                                    ON ar.SourceBudgetLineItemID = bli.BudgetLineItemID;
                        ROWSALLOCATED := SQLROWCOUNT;

                        -- Mark source items as allocated
                        UPDATE <%financial_planning%>.Planning.BudgetLineItem bli
                        SET
                                    IsAllocated = 1
                                FROM
                                    (
                                           SELECT DISTINCT
                                                SourceBudgetLineItemID
                                           FROM
                                                T_AllocationResults
                                       ) ar
                                WHERE
                                    bli.BudgetLineItemID = ar.SourceBudgetLineItemID;
                    END;
                    ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        -- Dry run - just return results
                        ROWSALLOCATED := (SELECT
                                    COUNT(*) FROM
                                    T_AllocationResults
                        );
                    END;
                    END IF;
                    -- =====================================================================
                    -- Build warning messages using STRING_AGG
                    -- =====================================================================
                    WARNINGMESSAGES := (
                        SELECT
                        LISTAGG(CONCAT('Rule ', COALESCE(AllocationRuleID :: STRING, ''), ': ', COALESCE(ErrorMessage :: STRING, '')),
                            '; '
                        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY QueueID)  -- STRING_AGG with ORDER BY
                        FROM
                        T_AllocationQueue
                        WHERE
                        ErrorMessage IS NOT NULL
                    );
                    -- Add iteration warning if max reached
                    IF (:ITERATIONCOUNT >= :MAXITERATIONS) THEN
                    BEGIN
                        WARNINGMESSAGES := CONCAT(COALESCE(:WARNINGMESSAGES :: STRING, ''),
                        '; WARNING: Max iterations (', COALESCE(:MAXITERATIONS :: STRING, ''), ') reached. Some allocations may be incomplete.');
                    END;
                    END IF;
                    COMMIT;
                    EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHER THEN
                        IF (CURRENT_TRANSACTION() IS NOT NULL) THEN
                        ROLLBACK AllocationTran !!!RESOLVE EWI!!! /*** SSC-EWI-0073 - PENDING FUNCTIONAL EQUIVALENCE REVIEW FOR 'RollbackName' NODE ***/!!!;
                        END IF;
                        WARNINGMESSAGES := :SQLERRM /*** SSC-FDM-TS0023 - ERROR MESSAGE COULD BE DIFFERENT IN SNOWFLAKE ***/;
                        RETURNCODE := :SQLCODE /*** SSC-FDM-TS0023 - ERROR NUMBER COULD BE DIFFERENT IN SNOWFLAKE ***/;
                    END;
                    CALL CleanupAndExit();
                END;
            CleanupAndExit PROCEDURE ()
            RETURNS VARCHAR
            AS
                BEGIN
                    -- Release application lock
                    IF (:CONCURRENCYMODE IN ('EXCLUSIVE', 'SHARED')) THEN
                    BEGIN
                        !!!RESOLVE EWI!!! /*** SSC-EWI-TS0075 - TRANSLATION FOR BUILT-IN PROCEDURE 'sp_releaseapplock' IS NOT CURRENTLY SUPPORTED. ***/!!!
                        EXEC sp_releaseapplock
                            @Resource = 'CostAllocation_Process',
                            @LockOwner = 'Session';
                    END;
                    END IF;
    -- Cleanup temp tables
                    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS T_AllocationQueue;
                    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS T_AllocationResults;
                    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS T_ProcessedRules;
                    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS T_RuleDependencies;
                    SC_EXIT_CODE := :RETURNCODE;
                END;
        BEGIN
            CALL SC_PROCESS();
            RETURN :SC_EXIT_CODE;
        END;
    $$;

USE DATABASE <%financial_planning%>;

/*
    usp_ExecuteCostAllocation - Step-down cost allocation with recursive dependencies

    Dependencies:
        - Tables: AllocationRule, BudgetLineItem, CostCenter, GLAccount
        - Views: vw_AllocationRuleTargets
        - Functions: fn_GetAllocationFactor
        - Types: AllocationResultTableType

    ============================================================================
    SNOWFLAKE MIGRATION CHALLENGES:
    ============================================================================
    1. Recursive CTE with self-referencing updates
    2. WAITFOR DELAY for throttling - No Snowflake equivalent
    3. sp_getapplock/sp_releaseapplock for locking - Different concurrency model
    4. Table variable as OUTPUT parameter (via workaround)
    5. Nested procedure calls with OUTPUT parameters
    6. GOTO statements for control flow
    7. Multiple temp tables with complex joins
    8. CROSS APPLY to inline TVF with correlation
    9. TRY_CONVERT and TRY_CAST functions
    10. STRING_AGG with ordering
    11. UPDATE with FROM clause and TOP
    12. @@ROWCOUNT immediately after UPDATE in complex expressions
    ============================================================================
*/
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE Planning.usp_ExecuteCostAllocation
    --** SSC-FDM-0041 - DEFAULT PARAMETERS WERE REORDERED TO THE END OF THE PARAMETER LIST TO MATCH SNOWFLAKE REQUIREMENTS. CALLERS USING POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS MAY NEED TO BE UPDATED **
